mapper.select: SELECT E.EMP_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, D.DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_CD, D.PRNT_DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_PRNT_DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_NM, D.USE_YN AS DEPARTMENT_USE_YN, D.FRST_REG_DT AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_REG_DT, D.FRST_RGTR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFCN_DT, D.LAST_MDFR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFR_ID, JP.JOB_PSTN_CD AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_CD, JP.JOB_PSTN_NM AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_NM, JP.USE_YN AS JOB_POSITION_USE_YN, JP.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_RGTR_ID, JP.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_REG_DT, JP.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFR_ID, JP.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFCN_DT, JG.JOB_GRD_CD AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_CD, JG.JOB_GRD_NM AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_NM, JG.USE_YN AS JOB_GRADE_USE_YN, JG.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_RGTR_ID, JG.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_REG_DT, JG.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFR_ID, JG.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE JG ON JG.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD WHERE E.EMP_ID = #{empId}
